# Brooklyn Bedding

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Online store on Shopify selling mattresses, pillows, sheets, duvet sets, mattress protection and toppers, plus some furniture. States free FedEx Ground shipping to the contiguous United States, paid shipping to Alaska, Hawaii and Canada, and no shipping to PO boxes or APO/FPO addresses. Lists showrooms.
